title: The zine on the counter
logline: A zine on Gully's counter by the end stool, left: stapled, quarter-letter, a crab on the cover drawn in a hand that isn't his. Gully's daughter's? The page doesn't open it. The corn tray beside it.

panels.composition: A stapled quarter-size zine lying on a shop counter beside an empty end stool, a crab drawn on its cover in a different hand, a paper tray beside it, the corkboard above.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a stapled small zine lying on a shop counter beside an empty end stool with a crab drawn on its cover, a paper tray beside it and a crowded corkboard above, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: A crab in another hand. Not opened.
